messages.author: a7b4b8806b78ccd8
messages.subject: simple_python meshparty and creating dotprops from skeletons created by using skeletor
parts:
Hi Greg,

My problems with meshparty persist. I completely removed my miniconda env and reinstalled it. When I run simple_python("full", miniconda=TRUE) meshparty version 0.2.2 is installed instead of the newest version. Is there a particular reason for that or is there sth wrong with my installation?

Another issue I am having is that it takes forever to create dotprops from skeletons created using skeletor(method = "wavefront", waves =1, step_size = 10). Do you have any recommendations?

Best
Ibo

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] simple_python meshparty and creating dotprops from skeletons created by using skeletor
parts:
Sorry to hear that, Ibo. 

Sent from my iPhone

My problems with meshparty persist. I completely removed my miniconda env and reinstalled it. When I run simple_python("full", miniconda=TRUE) meshparty version 0.2.2 is installed instead of the newest version. Is there a particular reason for that or is there sth wrong with my installation?

I think it’s because simple_python prefers binary installs

https://github.com/natverse/fafbseg/blob/d907d3bb6c5fa3104ba7fb66d4ca3b85dd5a15b9/R/utils.R#L378
Another issue I am having is that it takes forever to create dotprops from skeletons created using skeletor(method = "wavefront", waves =1, step_size = 10). Do you have any recommendations?

I haven’t played with those in some time. Do you mean the skeletor step or the dotprops is slow. If the latter are you sure that they are in microns not nm?


Best
Ibo
